newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby union-Waratahs lose Spooner and Bond for Wellington match.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Waratahs lose Spooner and Bond for Wellington match.

text.p: New South Wales will be without flyhalf Nathan Spooner and centre Graeme Bond for their Super 12 rugby union match against Wellington in Napier on Friday.
Spooner was ruled out because of a a partial shoulder dislocation while Bond has been sidelined by a back injury.
New South Wales coach Matt Williams, reeling from his side's humiliating 56-9 drubbing by ACT Brumbies on Saturday, will name his squad after training on Tuesday.
The Waratahs must beat Wellington to have any chance of qualifying for the Super 12 seminfinals. They will stay on in New Zealand for the clash with Otago on May 9.
